content_data.project_description: A comprehensive redesign initiative to enhance the accessibility and usability of our regional e-commerce platform for all users, focusing on WCAG 2.1 AA compliance and an inclusive user experience.
content_data.timeline: Over a 6-month period, with iterative releases every 6 weeks.
objectives: Improve user satisfaction metrics for users with diverse needs by at least 15%.
Increase conversion rates for assistive technology users by 10%.
deliverables: Accessibility Guidelines Document for development teams
technical_specs: Integration with existing e-commerce platform architecture.
Use of semantic HTML5 and ARIA attributes for accessibility.
Responsive design across various screen sizes (mobile, tablet, desktop).
Performance optimization for fast load times.
content_data.design_style: Clean, intuitive, and inclusive, with a focus on high contrast, clear typography, and simplified navigation. Emphasizes emotional connection through thoughtful use of imagery and micro-interactions.
